quote: We require our Model Hosts to have a SOC2 Type 2 report covering at least the Security, Confidentiality, and Availability trust principles, and active ISO 27001 certification.
fact: AI model hosts used for GitLab Duo must hold a SOC2 Type 2 report (Security, Confidentiality, Availability) and an active ISO 27001 certification.

quote: Refrain from training on GitLab's and GitLab's customers' private data, and commit to doing so contractually; and
fact: GitLab requires model hosts to not train on GitLab or customer private data and to commit to this in the contract.

quote: The GitLab Subprocessor distribution list is leveraged to provide 30-day notice of new AI vendors.
fact: Customers get 30 days' notice through the subprocessor distribution list before GitLab rolls out a new AI vendor.

quote: | Legal & Corporate Affairs (LACA) | Responsible for approving significant changes and exceptions to this procedure |
fact: Legal & Corporate Affairs (LACA) approves significant changes and exceptions to the AI Continuity Plan procedure.

quote: assuming the model is from an existing AI vendor and there is no other material change in the processing, no notification of change is triggered to customers.
fact: Switching to another model from an existing AI vendor, with no other material processing change, does not trigger a customer notification.

quote: | [Solution validation](#validation-solution-validation) | Not required. | Solution validation with 6 internal users. | Solution validation with 6 external users. |
fact: For AI feature UX maturity, Beta needs solution validation with 6 internal users and GA needs it with 6 external users; Experiment needs none.

quote: Develop a dataset of at least 500 evaluations that focus on the areas of risk you've identified.
fact: A high-confidence, high-risk AI feature must build an evaluation dataset of at least 500 evaluations focused on the identified risk areas.

quote: High confidence = strong evidence from 2 or more customer facing sources (see below).
fact: High confidence in AI output quality means strong evidence from two or more customer-facing sources.

quote: take turns shadowing the Chief Product Officer (CPO) for a specified period of time ranging from 1 to 2 weeks
fact: A CPO Shadow rotation lasts 1 to 2 weeks and focuses on customer-facing meetings, so travel is required.

quote: The CPO Shadow Program is not a performance evaluation or the next step to a promotion.
fact: Being a CPO Shadow is not a performance evaluation and is not a step toward or requirement for promotion.

quote: | Deck / memo due to CFO team | 10 business days before board meeting |
fact: The Product/R&D board deck and memo are due to the CFO team 10 business days before the board meeting (David reviews them at 12 business days).

quote: | Self Managed: Cloud Licensing | 😍 Lovable |
fact: The Provision group rates Self-Managed Cloud Licensing at Lovable maturity, while Self-Managed trial provisioning is only Minimal.

quote: A reminder that the bar for key talent is set high, and that key talent makes up roughly ~10% of the entire population.
fact: Key Talent is expected to be about 10% of the population, and in Product only Directors and above make Key Talent nominations.

quote: Set an expectation with the intern's current manager that the intern will give > 40% of their time to the internship.
fact: A Product Management intern for learning is expected to spend more than 40% of their time on the internship.

quote: Today, all customers are charged for seat overages. In the future, the default experience will require customers to purchase seats before they can be assigned to users.
fact: Seat Management plans to change the default so customers must buy seats before assigning them, instead of being charged for overages.

quote: | LDAP Group Sync | 😊 Viable | Hourly sync of user and group information from LDAP directories |
fact: LDAP Group Sync syncs user and group information hourly and is rated Viable.

quote: Invest the majority of your time (say 70%) in deeply understanding the problem.
fact: PMs should spend about 70% of their time understanding the problem, 10% writing the first-iteration spec, and 20% promoting it.

quote: 10.0 = Impacts the vast majority (~80% or greater) of our users, prospects, or customers
fact: In GitLab's RICE scoring, a Reach of 10.0 means the change affects about 80% or more of users, prospects, or customers.

quote: (Reach x Impact x Confidence) / Effort = RICE
fact: The RICE score is Reach times Impact times Confidence divided by Effort (in person-months).

quote: consistently maintaining our [99.95% SLA on GitLab.com]
fact: GitLab aims to keep a 99.95% availability SLA on GitLab.com.

quote: Accordingly, the direction pages are expected to refer to specific issues only for the next 3-4 months.
fact: Direction pages should only name specific issues for the next 3-4 months; beyond that they should discuss topics.

quote: Contact the CProdO EBA to schedule a 25 minute meeting.
fact: An Opportunity Canvas review with leadership is a 25-minute meeting booked through the CProdO's EBA.

quote: Users should never be contacted by more than one GitLab team member. Users should never be contacted more than twice if they do not respond to an outreach email.
fact: In USAT+ responder outreach, each user is contacted by only one team member and at most twice if they don't reply.

quote: we can never remove features from Core into paid tiers
fact: Under the stewardship policy, GitLab never moves features out of Core into paid tiers.

quote: This resulted in GitLab stopping investment in Serverless.
fact: GitLab stopped investing in Serverless because its strategy relied on immature technology not aligned with market winner Lambda.

quote: our [integration with Jira Cloud](https://docs.gitlab.com/integration/jira/connect-app/) is called `GitLab.com for Jira Cloud`.
fact: The Jira Cloud integration is named 'GitLab.com for Jira Cloud', using a preposition to show the third party isn't affiliated.

quote: EBRs are usually quite long (60-90 minutes) and the product presentation is only a small portion (15-20 minutes) of the overall EBR
fact: Executive Business Reviews last 60-90 minutes, of which the product presentation is only 15-20 minutes.

quote: The CProdO is the DRI for the product budget and all changes or requests for budget spend must be approved through them.
fact: The Chief Product Officer is DRI for the product budget and approves all budget spend requests.

quote: p > 0.05 and p < 0.2: experiment **"had a directional impact"**
fact: For pseudo-RCT experiments, a p-value between 0.05 and 0.2 is reported as a 'directional impact'.

quote: The long-term target for the Product Managers per Product Analyst ratio is 3:1.
fact: The Product Data Insights gearing ratio target is 3 PMs per product analyst (it was about 7:1).

quote: If a single issue has a weight greater than the length of the iteration (2 weeks), it should be
fact: Product Data Insights works in 2-week iterations and splits any issue weighted longer than one iteration.

quote: They are consumed first (highest burndown priority), do not reset monthly, cannot go negative, and expire 30 days from the day they are provisioned by default.
fact: Duo Agent Platform bonus trial credits are used first, don't reset monthly, can't go negative, and expire 30 days after provisioning by default.

quote: | Greater than 10,000 | CPMO (Manav Khurana) |
fact: First-time DAP bonus trial credit requests above 10,000 credits need approval from the CPMO, Manav Khurana.

quote: Extension can be generated 1-15 days before subscription end date or 1-13 days after subscription end date, with a default expiration date of 21 days after subscription end date
fact: A temporary renewal extension can be created 1-15 days before or 1-13 days after subscription end and by default runs 21 days past the end date.

quote: customers are placed on support hold when accounts become >90 days past due without payment commitment
fact: Accounts over 90 days past due with no payment commitment go on support hold, which excludes them from quarterly seat reconciliation.

quote: The meeting should take place on Tuesdays for 50 min
fact: The weekly Growth meeting run by the Growth PM Director is held on Tuesdays for 50 minutes.

quote: The fixed windows are set as the Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of the three weeks preceding the major release date, typically following the X.11 release date.
fact: Since GitLab 17.0, breaking changes on GitLab.com roll out only on Monday-Wednesday of the three weeks before a major release.

quote: Maintenance - Categories where no new features will added
fact: A category with Maintenance investment status gets no new features.

quote: Requires **PLT + Required Approver approval**, mention PMM for awareness.
fact: Very significant category changes, such as removing a category or moving a feature up or down a tier, need PLT and Required Approver approval.

quote: We will not implement telemetry in our products which sends identifiable usage data to a third-party product analytics service
fact: GitLab commits never to send identifiable usage data to third-party product analytics services.

quote: Reducing the duration of code review is the [primary metric of success of the Code Review group]
fact: The Code Review group's main success metric is shorter code review duration.
